observation.guidance: Continue to observe for any return to a colored endoscopic view following the grayscale imaging. Ensure to note any identifiable changes in the imaging or instruments present, focusing on the appearance of a clear tube or woven material.
observation.principle: Do not assume continuity between cuts in the view; each sequence should be assessed individually for its specific visible content.
